tripAdvisorReviews.name: Premier Inn London Leicester Square Hotel
tripAdvisorReviews.address: Queens House 1 Leicester Square, London WC2H 7BP England

reviews.title: Reliable Premier Inn
reviews.text:
We like to book Premier Inn as we know we’ll get a decent room. What was really good about this one was how quiet the room was considering we were in the middle of London. 
The only disappointing aspect was the breakfast, the hot food was overcooked with bacon so tough it was difficult to eat. There are plenty of other food options close to the hotel so I wouldn’t bother to book breakfast at the hotel again. That’s the only reason I have dropped a star. 
The staff were all pleasant and helpful

reviews.title: Clean,comfortable  and central hotel supported by excellent team of staff
reviews.text: Clean and comfortable hotel very conveniently located for central sights, theatre and restaurants. Excellent team of staff - very friendly, helpful and worked well together as a team motivated by the example of Jackie their very effective manager. Breakfast was exceptionally good and good value. The cooked breakfast was very tastefullly prepared by their chef, Patricia who succeeded to maintain its freshly prepared presentation right up to the end of the breakfast time slot.

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text:
★★★★★ Amazing Stay – Highly Recommend!

I had an incredible experience. From the moment I arrived, the staff was welcoming, professional, and always ready to assist with a smile. The check-in process was smooth and efficient, setting the tone for a fantastic stay.
The room was spotless, spacious, and beautifully decorated, with a super comfortable bed and a stunning view. Every little detail was thoughtfully arranged.

reviews.title: Overall a very nice experience
reviews.text:
The hotel is very clean , nice atmosphere the bathrooms are clean , the rooms and beds are very nice too 
i really like the vibes over there and very friendly staff too , the manager is very receptive as well and tries to be as helpful as possible , if you have any kind of request they will totally help you out !

reviews.title: The staff was amazing!
reviews.text: The staff was extremely helpful, accommodative and insightful! 10/10 experience! Whenever I needed assistance or had an issue they would go the extra extra mile to make sure everything was in order and any issue I had was well taken care off, honestly one of the best stays I've had.
